slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round; its tables are counts of countries and it names Liberia only in the annex score bands: digitization under 35% (one of 21 countries), infrastructure and resources 35-49%, planning and coordination 35-49%, registration process 35-49%, legal framework 65-79%, overall 35-49%. Liberia's own answers on electronic capture at local offices are not given, so no aspect value can be taken and no system is named.
